propositions: The dedup key (_JiraSanitizer.fit_comment using truncate_comment_body with 32767 char cap) diverges from what the send path lands (fit_preserving_marker with AdfCodec.fit_outbound measuring serialized ADF at 32000), so body-equality dedup cannot match for over-length comments
For a 43200-char comment, the dedup key yields 32767 chars while the sent body is 31753 chars due to serialized ADF fitting and marker budget reservation, with first divergence at index 31725
The comparison key was identical to the sent body prior to commit 27b868ba55, which moved the send path to codec.fit_outbound while leaving the dedup key on truncate_comment_body
Body-equality dedup is the guard against lost map writes between add_comment and record_comment_id, and is structurally dead for over-length comments due to the fit divergence
The fix restores the shared-fitter invariant by making _JiraSanitizer.fit_comment return fit_comment_as_sent (marker-free text the send path actually lands) instead of truncate_comment_body
Dedup keys are never persisted, only computed in memory each pass, so the change can only ADD skips and cannot re-post already-landed comments
